Description: Susceptible people become infected through exposure to contaminated water.
Infectious people recover from the disease and become immune.
Infectious people shed bacteria, contaminating the water supply.

Name: R0
Description: The basic reproduction number, defined as the number of individuals that an infected individual can infect when introduced into a completely susceptible population.

Name: λ
Description: The force of infection. The rate of cholera transmission is a product of the force of infection and the size of the susceptible population.

Name: β
Description: The rate of “contact” between the susceptible population with contaminated water.

Name: κ
Description: The concentration of V. cholerae at which the infection rate is 50% of the maximum infection rate.

Name: γ
Description: The per capita recovery rate, which is the reciprocal of the duration of infection.

Name: 1/δ
Description: Cholera life span in water reservoir.

Name: δ
Description: The decay rate of cholera in the water reservoir, which is the reciprocal of the cholera life span.

Name: ξ
Description: The rate of water contamination by infectious people shedding V. cholerae into the water reservoir.
